analysis.transcript_summary: The user reported receiving an incorrect size (L instead of XL) for a cotton kurta order (order number 48291673). The agent confirmed the correct size (XL) was available and arranged an exchange. The pickup for the exchange is scheduled for Friday, October 9th, between 10 AM and 1 PM, with the delivery partner exchanging the items. The agent emphasized the importance of the price tag remaining on the kurta, which the user confirmed was intact. The exchange was successfully confirmed.
